statement: For k pure record vectors in complex dimension d, the average off-diagonal squared Gram overlap is at least max(0,(k-d)/(d(k-1))).
pdt_corollary: Average pairwise revelation proxy 1-|G_ij|^2 is at most 1-max(0,(k-d)/(d(k-1))).
prior_art: First Welch bound (Welch, IEEE Trans. Information Theory, 1974).
